provenance.method: Owned A long-pressed its own sticker-with-text log (observed-direct-sticker-with-text.json) in the owned A/B direct chat about 30 minutes after sending it. The menu offered Edit. The edit composer showed only the text; with the field emptied no send control was shown. A typed a synthetic replacement and sent it once; A's client then labelled the message Edited. B's scoped read-only SYNCMSG probe recorded the feed log, and a read-only GETMSGS for the target recorded the edited log. Log IDs and the sticker path are synthetic. The edited log's sticker path equalled the original's; other attachment keys were not compared, so only path is listed.

syncmsg: A SYNCMSG read seconds after the edit returned the target with its original text; a read a few minutes later returned it with the edited text. Both reads returned the feed log after the target's replies.
